run_async_download_test: run the TestDriver test to verify concurrent Azure blob file downloads with multiprocessing
create_remote_test_file: create a random binary test file on Azure Blob storage using the AzureBlobPathHandler
download_files_concurrent: download files from Azure Blob to a local cache directory using multiple worker processes

test_cached_file_locking: test cached file locking behavior during concurrent downloads of Azure blob files
